notes.title: Labyrinth of Rage V. 1.0
notes.content:
Labyrinth of Rage V. 1.0 out now! Enjoy the full campaign!
Feel free to stream the album on Spotify or Apple Music under "Labyrinth of Rage (Original Game Soundtrack) by Eric Paterson"

Thank you for taking the time to play my first video game. I hope you enjoy the experience.

notes.title: V. 0.9 now available
notes.content: Bug Fixes, second boss now available. Good luck!

notes.title: Labyrinth of Rage V. 0.5 Update Notes
notes.content:
- Added Stats information to Equipment page
- Re-designed levels
- Adjusted first boss stats (Grand Spider Demon King)
- Minor enemies now drop items

notes.title: Labyrinth of Rage V. 0.4 now available!
notes.content:
V. 0.4 now available:

Updates include:

- Level Re-Design
- New 2D Art
- New Soundtrack
- New Items
- Minor Updates to Post-Processing and UI

notes.title: V. 0.2.1 - Bug Patches
notes.content:
V. 0.2.1 Just released Sept. 3rd 2023.

Patches Included:

- Fixed bug in Main Menu where Tutorial level would not load.
- Removed Motion Blur from camera
- Minor UI Adjustment for in game HUD.

Future updates include Combat functionality, lighting settings, and additional enemies.

notes.title: Labyrinth of Rage now available for Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello! Welcome to the Labyrinth of Rage community forum. Today I am pleased to announce the Early Access of Labyrinth of Rage is now available on Steam! Feel free to play, and leave any feedback you wish either here or any of our social platforms

www.linktr.ee/labyrinthofrage
